# T4: report.to_csv exports the ledger

Add stocklib.report.to_csv(ledger) returning CSV text: a header row 'sku,quantity', then one row per SKU in sorted SKU order, each line ending in '\n' (including the last). Quote fields per RFC 4180 (use the csv module), so a SKU containing a comma is quoted. An empty ledger yields only the header line.
------
diff --git a/stocklib/report.py b/stocklib/report.py
index 7e6d7f2..3ed6cc8 100644
--- a/stocklib/report.py
+++ b/stocklib/report.py
@@ -1,5 +1,8 @@
 """Plain-text reports over a Ledger."""
 
+import csv
+import io
+
 
 def totals(ledger):
     return int(sum(ledger.quantity(sku) for sku in ledger.skus()))
@@ -9,3 +12,12 @@ def summary(ledger):
     lines = [f"{sku}: {ledger.quantity(sku)}" for sku in ledger.skus()]
     lines.append(f"TOTAL {totals(ledger)}")
     return "\n".join(lines)
+
+
+def to_csv(ledger):
+    out = io.StringIO()
+    writer = csv.writer(out, lineterminator="\n")
+    writer.writerow(["sku", "quantity"])
+    for sku in ledger.skus():
+        writer.writerow([sku, ledger.quantity(sku)])
+    return out.getvalue()
